source_text: Video aliam legem in membris meis repugnantem legi mentis meae et captivum me ducentem in lege peccati. Infelix ego homo: quis me liberabit de corpore mortis huius?
pass_a_gloss: I see another law in my members fighting against the law of my mind and leading me captive in the law of sin. Wretched man that I am: who will free me from this body of death?
pass_b_english: [[I see in my members another law waging war against the law of my mind >> Bible:Romans 7:23]]. [[Wretched man that I am! Who will deliver me from this body of death? >> Bible:Romans 7:24]].
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Romans.
